artists.name: Naomi Siolo
artists.tagline: "Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding."  — Proverbs 3:5-6
artists.bio:
Naomi Siolo is a solo Christian pop singer and songwriter. Starting by sharing original songs online, Naomi blends uplifting melodies with heartfelt lyrics that reflect her faith.

What she does: writes all of her music independently, creating inspiring Christian pop songs that encourage hope, worship, and a deeper connection with God.

artists.name: Mia Herak
artists.tagline: "For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God."  — Ephesians 2:8-9
artists.bio: Mia Herak is a powerful gospel singer whose incredibly strong and soulful vocals captivate audiences with every performance. Blending passionate melodies with heartfelt faith, Mia's music centers on God, hope, and sharing the message of Jesus through song.

artists.name: Matilda Burns
artists.tagline: "What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?"  — Romans 8:31
artists.bio: Matilda Burns creates heartfelt slow-pop ballads that blend gentle melodies with powerful messages of faith. Through her reflective songwriting and emotional vocals, Matilda shares stories of hope, grace, and her relationship with Jesus.

artists.name: Tadhg Jones
artists.bio: Tadhg Jones reimagines contemporary guitar music through a laid-back fusion of lo-fi textures and jazz-inspired improvisation. Relaxing instrumental soundscapes that blend the warmth of jazz with nostalgic character.
